summary: A producer and its consumer under the real control plane, on two Rentals at one price that can neither of them list the Artifact copies they hold. The producer's image decides where it goes: only one of the two machines holds it, so that is where the checkpoint is computed, written, and uploaded from. The consumer runs a different image both machines hold whole, so nothing about images, price, room, or queueing separates the two candidates by the time it arrives. What separates them is the record the object store kept when the checkpoint was published, and the consumer prefers that machine by the 160 second read it would not make there. The world then confirms the estimate: the consumer's own read resolves against the local copy rather than the object store, which is the transfer the preference said would be avoided. Both machines being silent is the point, because a machine that can enumerate its copies needs no record to be preferred, and no runtime in the tree enumerates content a workload wrote for itself.
